_doc: Per-host access-pattern registry. Updated automatically when extract_assets.py probes a new URL host. Hand-edit to refine notes / method / auth_required, but DO NOT remove fields.

_schema.host_pattern: str: glob-like host pattern. Match precedence: longest most-specific first.
_schema.url_regex: str|null: extra regex on the full URL when host alone isn't enough.
_schema.notes: str: free-form. Edge cases, fragility, alternative mirrors.
_schema.verified_at: str: ISO date the pattern was last hand-verified.

patterns.notes: Public repos: no auth. Gated repos (LLaMA-2/3, Mistral, Gemma) need 'login' + accepted license. Switch auth_required to 'gated_license' on a per-repo basis.
Direct file fetch at a specific commit/branch. No size limit but discouraged for >100MB.
Public release assets. Up to 2GB per asset.
For LFS-tracked files in github.com/.../blob/..., GitHub returns a tiny pointer; need git-lfs. See github_lfs pattern.

patterns.method: git clone --depth 1 (for repo content) or curl raw URL
patterns.notes: Generic GitHub repo URL. Catch-all when no more specific path matches.
GitHub LFS object server. URLs are short-lived signed.
JSON API at /api/dataset returns canonical static.csv link + metadata (instances, features, MB). Rate limit observed at ~10 req/min.

patterns.method: Resolve DOI -> archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/<id> -> use UCI JSON API
patterns.notes: 10.24432 is UCI ML Repo's DOI prefix. All redirect to UCI dataset pages.

patterns.method: Resolve DOI -> Zenodo record API at zenodo.org/api/records/<id>
patterns.notes: 10.5281 is Zenodo's DOI prefix. Files exposed under .files[].links.self.

patterns.method: HTTP HEAD/GET to follow redirect, then re-classify by final host
patterns.notes: Generic DOI. Resolve to canonical landing page first.
Public records: no auth. Restricted records require Zenodo token.
Public articles only. Private articles need OAuth token.
Public datasets are anonymous. API key only needed for upload.
Requires ~/.kaggle/kaggle.json. Some datasets also require accepting terms in the browser first.
Must join the competition (accept rules) in the browser before API download works.
gdown handles public folders <50 files. Larger folders hit Google's quota; tar/zip the folder and share as a single file is more reliable.
Public 'anyone with link' files only. Confirmation token may be needed for >100MB. Daily download quota per file.
docs.google.com share links resolve through the same Drive backend.

patterns.method: Open in browser, accept anonymous-tenant FedAuth cookie, click download. Optionally automate with Playwright headed-mode.
patterns.notes: Personal SharePoint shares (e.g. portland-my.sharepoint.com) issue a tenantanon FedAuth cookie. Direct curl to the download endpoint returns HTTP 403 without that cookie. No documented public API.

patterns.method: Append &download=1 to the share URL, follow redirects
patterns.notes: Public 'anyone with link' shares are scriptable via curl -L with the &download=1 trick. Folder downloads are zipped on the fly.
Short-link form. Same flow as onedrive.live.com after redirect.

patterns.method: Manual: Baidu account + extraction code (4 chars in brackets next to URL). bypy CLI works only for one's own account.
patterns.notes: Account creation requires a Chinese mobile number. No public API. Extraction code typically printed in paper or README in form '[abcd]' or '提取码: abcd'.
Old hostname for Baidu Pan; same constraints.
Works for public share links of any size. Folder shares download as zip.
Anonymous downloads work but rate-limited (~5 GB / 6 hr per IP). Free account raises limit.

patterns.method: Scrape direct download link from share page; rate-limited
patterns.notes: Heavy ad pages and dynamic redirect tokens. Use mediafire-dl or similar.

patterns.method: gsutil cp gs://<bucket>/<obj> . OR curl -L (for public buckets)
patterns.notes: Public-read buckets work with curl. Private buckets need gcloud auth.

patterns.method: aws s3 cp s3://<bucket>/<key> . OR curl -L (public-read)
patterns.notes: Public-read buckets work without credentials. Requester-pays buckets need AWS auth.
Path-style S3 URL form.
Anonymous public-read containers work with curl.

patterns.method: Fill request form on ai.meta.com/resources/models-and-libraries -> emailed download URL valid 24h
patterns.notes: LLaMA family. Email-gated; cannot be scripted.
Use HuggingFace meta-llama/* mirror instead — auto-resolved when paper says 'LLaMA-2-7b'.

patterns.method: Register at image-net.org with academic email; wait for approval; download tar.gz files
patterns.notes: ImageNet-1K (ILSVRC2012). Mirror via HF dataset 'imagenet-1k' is preferred.

patterns.method: Register on competition page; some bundles have a Worksheet 'download' link.
patterns.notes: Often the actual data lives elsewhere; CodaLab is just the eval submission portal.
Submission portal; data hosted elsewhere.

patterns.method: Resolve to upstream link; PwC just aggregates
patterns.notes: Always re-classify by the linked host.
